title: Scalar tensor coefficient respects the two unit maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $F$ any $\mathcal O_X$-module. Write $S_f$ for scalar restriction, $U=\mathcal O_X$, $v:\mathbf1\to S_fU$ for scalarUnitMorphism, and $c_{F,G}:S_fF\otimes_k S_fG\to S_f(F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}G)$ for scalarTensorCoefficient [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Both morphism equalities hold: $(S_fF\mathbin{\triangleleft}v);c_{F,U};S_f(\rho_F)=\rho_{S_fF}$ and $(v\mathbin{\triangleright}S_fF);c_{U,F};S_f(\lambda_F)=\lambda_{S_fF}$. No cohomology classes occur in these equalities.

source.place: Cohomology, section-cup-product, Lemma 20.31.1 (Tag 0FKU); Tag 01F7; Modules, Tags 0096 and 01CA

proof.text: Prove the scalar unit formula on every open: precompose the underlying scalarUnitMorphism with the lax monoidal unit of sheafToPresheaf. The sheafification adjunction unit_app_unit_comp_map_eta, followed by monoidal eta_epsilon, identifies this composite with the constant-presheaf adjoint of scalarUnitLinear. The counit of constantPresheafAdj restricts the global scalar section to the given open, giving scalarMap f U r.

For the right identity, cancel the inverse right unitor and apply faithfulness of sheafToPresheaf. LaxMonoidal.right_unitality_inv and tensorator naturality express the resulting presheaf map on a section s as the tensorator applied to s tensor the image of 1 under the scalar unit, followed by the tensor coefficient and module right unitor. The scalar unit formula and exists_scalarTensorCoefficient reduce this to the module right unitor on tmulSection s 1. The proved source-library rightUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection and one_smul give s. Repeat with left_unitality_inv and leftUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection for 1 tensor s. These are ordinary sectionwise equalities and require no nonzero sections, so include zero modules and the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensorCoefficient_unit
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F : X.Modules) :
    ((scalarSheaf f F) ◁ scalarUnitMorphism f) ≫
        scalarTensorCoefficient f F (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≫
        scalarHom f (ρ_ F).hom = (ρ_ (scalarSheaf f F)).hom ∧
    (scalarUnitMorphism f ▷ (scalarSheaf f F)) ≫
        scalarTensorCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) F ≫
        scalarHom f (λ_ F).hom = (λ_ (scalarSheaf f F)).hom
